descriptions.tsonnet_c31_text_size_802b1880: Returns the cached float at offset 172 of the owner; when it equals the zero constant, refills it from the float at offset 64 of the object at offset 12 and, if still equal to zero, from a named property lookup converted by two helpers, releasing the lookup reference through its fifth virtual slot; field meanings are inferred and the lookup string and constant are external originals.
